description: Apply the safe fixes that lint_entries points to and return the cleaned list as BibTeX: page ranges with one hyphen get a double hyphen, titles that start with a lower case letter or are all lower case get capitals (words inside braces are left alone), and DOIs written as a link or with a doi: prefix become bare DOIs. Missing fields, backwards page ranges and DOIs that are not valid are not guessed, so run lint_entries on the result. Example: pages "12-15" becomes "12--15". Your files are not changed.

format.description: The format of the text. Defaults to auto, which looks at the text to decide.

text.description: The reference list as text: BibTeX, RIS or CSL JSON.

name: fix_entries
title: Fix entries
